channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Luta feroz': veja como a imprensa estrangeira noticiou o julgamento no STF
item.description: The STF hearing that may investigate Alexandre de Moraes sparked internal crisis at the court, drawing international attention ahead of October elections. Major foreign outlets highlight the clashes between justices and the severity of the situation.

item.title: Lula: Meu filho não tem proteção, só quero que ele tenha a igualdade que há para todos
item.description: In an interview with Record, President Lula stated that his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) has no special protection and will face legal consequences like any other citizen if he commits an offense. He emphasized his commitment to ensuring the equality enshrined in the law for all Brazilians, regardless of family ties.

item.title: Lula diz que Bolsonaro tinha ministros da Saúde 'mequetrefes' e abandonou setor
item.description: Lula called Bolsonaro's Health ministers 'mequetrefes' and criticized the previous administration for abandoning the sector. The statement was made during an interview on TV Record.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Dino e 'tropa de choque de Lula no STF' protegeram Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the postponement of the STF decision regarding an investigation against Alexandre de Moraes, blaming Minister Flávio Dino and associating Moraes with President Lula. The PL candidate labeled Moraes as part of Lula's 'shock troops at the STF'.

item.title: Lula: Vamos anunciar na sexta um plano para a segurança do RJ ao lado do governador
item.description: Lula announced he will unveil a security plan for Rio de Janeiro on Friday, involving cooperation between federal, state, and municipal governments. The statement was made during an interview with TV Record.

item.title: Lula diz que BC independente não resolveu os problemas econômicos
item.description: Lula advocates for presidential interference in the economy and criticizes the independence of the Central Bank, stating that it does not solve the country's economic problems. In an interview with Record, the president emphasized the need for greater government control over national economic policies.

item.title: ‘Tristeza e consternação’: o desabafo de Cármen Lúcia no julgamento sobre investigação de Moraes no STF
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia expressed deep sadness and dismay during the hearing regarding the potential investigation into Minister Alexandre de Moraes, taking responsibility for the crisis in the Court and apologizing to the Brazilian people. She emphasized the importance of focusing solely on Moraes' case, unlike other colleagues, and highlighted her alignment with President Edson Fachin.

item.title: Lula anuncia plano para segurança no Rio de Janeiro na 6ª feira
item.description: President Lula announced the launch of a public security plan for Rio de Janeiro in partnership with interim governor Ricardo Couto, focusing on combating drug trafficking and arms smuggling. In an interview with TV Record, Lula emphasized the need to create the Ministry of Public Security and stressed the importance of increasing the staffing of the Federal Police, the Federal Highway Police, and intelligence budgets. He also distinguished between state terrorism and terrorism linked to drug trafficking and organized crime.

item.title: A nova pesquisa presidencial AtlasIntel no estado natal de Flávio
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll will be conducted in Rio de Janeiro from September 15 to 20, 2026, with 1,800 interviews and a 2-point margin of error. The survey covers elections for President, state governor, and Senate, mentioning 12 presidential candidates including Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema. For governor, names like Eduardo Paés, Garotinho, and Douglas Ruas are included, while for Senate, Benedita da Silva, Carlos Jordy, and Waguinho are listed.

item.title: Justiça manda Arruda apagar vídeo sobre advogado: "Descontextualizado"
item.description: The 20th Civil Court of Brasília ordered José Roberto Arruda to remove from his social media a video linking lawyer Engels Augusto Muniz's office to payments made by former banker Daniel Vorcaro, deeming the claim misleading and out of context, with a daily fine of R$ 5,000 and an additional R$ 10,000 per new similar post.

item.title: Após TSE barrar candidatura de Marçal, PRTB anuncia Avalanche ao Planalto
item.description: The PRTB replaced Pablo Marçal, barred by the TSE due to ineligibility until 2032, with Leonardo Avalanche as the presidential candidate. The change was filed with the Electoral Court and is already recorded in the TSE system.

item.title: Em campanha por SP, Augusto Cury atende eleitores em frente ao Masp
item.description: Augusto Cury, Avante presidential candidate, stated during a campaign event in São Paulo that politicians involved in the Vorcaro investigations should be convicted and not receive votes. He criticized delays in Supreme Court trials and called for public, swift proceedings to ensure transparency in the October elections.

item.title: Sessão do STF teve Cármen atônita, Mendonça em oração e gargalhadas na sala de lanches
item.description: A session at the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) was filled with intense debates and mutual accusations, leaving Justice Cármen Lúcia visibly stunned, while Justice Mendonça was seen praying. The judicial confrontation sparked significant public debate during the election campaign.

item.title: ‘Espetáculo degradante’ e pizza: presidenciáveis reagem à conclusão de sessão no STF
item.description: Following the STF session regarding the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, several presidential candidates voiced their opinions, criticizing the confrontational atmosphere in the court and emphasizing the need for transparent investigations. Lula supported rigorous investigation proceedings and the opening of state secrets, while other candidates mocked or condemned the episode as a degrading spectacle to the country's institutions.

item.title: Em dia de julgamento no STF, Flávio Bolsonaro liga Lula a Moraes, e presidente explora investigação contra senador em horário eleitoral
item.description: During the STF hearing, the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula erupted in TV attacks. Flávio linked Lula to Moraes, accusing the government of institutional imbalance, while Lula highlighted investigations against the senator and the strength of the PF under his administration.

item.title: Professor de Processo Penal analisa votos do STF durante sessão da Corte
item.description: Professor of Criminal Procedure Rodrigo Chemim provides a technical analysis of Supreme Court ministers' votes, emphasizing legal foundations and constitutional impacts.

item.title: Lula diz que não protegerá Lulinha: "Meu filho não nasceu para errar"
item.description: President Lula stated his son Lulinha will not be protected and will face consequences if guilty, emphasizing investigations must proceed with rigor. He called for full transparency and maintains belief in his son's innocence until proven otherwise.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia diz que crise no STF causa 'mal-estar cívico' no país
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia expressed deep sadness and consternation regarding the crisis at the Supreme Federal Court, highlighting the 'civic unrest' caused among Brazilian citizens. During a session marked by conflicts between ministers, she apologized to the people for not taking a different stance and emphasized the media spectacle of the cases as harmful to the country. The session addressed possible investigations into Minister Alexandre de Moraes and his relationship with former banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Luis César Bueno fala sobre plano de mobilidade urbana e retomada da política de implantação dos BRTs
item.description: Luís César Bueno (PT) proposed a State Urban Mobility Plan focused on the metropolitan regions of Goiânia and Brasília, defending the resumption of BRT investments and the implementation of free fare. In an interview with O Popular and CBN radio, the candidate also addressed infrastructure, education and public security.

item.title: Veja como foi a terça-feira (15) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: Presidential candidates carried out varied agendas on May 15th, including rallies, interviews, and campaign events across different states. Ronaldo Caiado stood out with his Supreme Court reform proposals, while Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the court crisis and advocated for public security policies. Most candidates used social media to share their positions and engage with voters.

item.title: Lula diz que Mendonça promovia vazamentos seletivos e defende reforma no Judiciário
item.description: Lula accused André Mendonça of selectively leaking information in the Master case and advocated for deep judicial reform, including term limits and minister selection criteria. He also emphasized the need to investigate suspected irregularities involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Lula defende investigação sobre relação de Moraes com Vorcaro
item.description: President Lula supported investigations at the Supreme Federal Court regarding the connections of Minister Alexandre de Moraes with former banker Daniel Vrocaro, emphasizing the importance of judgment when there is suspicion and accusation. He stressed that no one can escape justice at a crucial moment for the country.

item.title: Gilmar pressiona Mendonça e STF não decide se abre investigação sobre mensagens de Vorcaro e Moraes
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court's plenary session ended without deciding whether to open an investigation involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro. Gilmar Mendes pressured Justice André Mendonça and questioned the investigation's conduct, while justices remained split over joint or separate handling of the cases. Justice Flávio Dino requested more time, leading to a technical deadlock, and new messages involving relatives of other justices were also revealed.

item.title: Internautas citam revolta no Nepal em protesto contra Moraes
item.description: Brazilian netizens linked the 2025 Nepal protests to the STF session discussing an investigation against Alexandre de Moraes, suggesting similar mobilizations in Brazil due to discontent with 'impunity'. The session was postponed after Minister Flávio Dino requested a review, possibly delaying it until after October elections.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute “luta feroz” no STF
item.description: International media highlighted the 'ferocious fight' at the STF during a session debating a unprecedented investigation against one of its justices. The moment reflects internal tensions within the court and the approaching 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Nova pesquisa AtlasIntel mostra a disputa Lula x Flávio no segundo maior colégio eleitoral do país
item.description: AtlasIntel conducted a survey in Minas Gerais, Brazil's second-largest electoral college, covering the presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, as well as gubernatorial and Senate elections. Registered with the TSE, the poll forecasts 1,800 interviews from September 15–20, 2026, with results released on September 21, and a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: Moraes e Mendonça deveriam ser impedidos de votar? Juristas respondem perguntas de leitores da BBC
item.description: The STF session was suspended after debates on whether to investigate Justice Alexandre de Moraes and handle separately the cases involving Justice André Mendonça. Most justices voted to keep the cases separate, while some abstained from voting.

item.title: PRTB troca Marçal por Avalanche na corrida à Presidência
item.description: The PRTB replaced disqualified candidate Pablo Marçal with Leonardo Avalanche as its 2026 presidential nominee. The change follows the TSE's definitive rejection of Marçal's registration.

item.title: Lulômetro: Desaprovação de Lula mantém alta e chega a 42%
item.description: President Lula (PT)'s disapproval rating rose to 42% in the Lulômetro, remaining high since late last month. Only 28% rate the administration as 'great/good', while 29% consider it 'regular'. The daily tracking is conducted by O Antagonista in partnership with Real Time Big Data.

item.title: Candidatos de direita falam em 'pizza' após pedido de vista de Dino no STF
item.description: Right-wing candidates and figures used the term 'pizza' to criticize Supreme Court President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after the extraordinary session was closed following a request for adjournment by Alexandre de Moraes. The reaction occurred after a session addressing the constitutionality of public security laws.

item.title: 'Não tem trégua, precisa investigar todos', diz Lula sobre ministros do STF
item.description: Lula calls for investigating all Supreme Court justices involved in the Master case and advocates for judicial reform in an interview with Record.

item.title: Condenados da lista de Vorcaro “não merecem voto”, diz Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) stated that voters should not support politicians linked to Daniel Vorcaro's investigations if they are convicted. The remarks were made during a campaign event on Avenida Paulista while the STF discussed opening investigations. The candidate used the issue to criticize corruption and reinforce his anti-corruption stance.

item.title: Tarcísio suspende agenda de campanha em São Paulo após fortes chuvas
item.description: Governor and candidate Tarcísio de Freitas suspended his campaign schedule in São Paulo following heavy rains that left three dead and two missing. The Civil Defense served roughly 2,000 people in the affected region, while Tarcísio prioritized government action and distributed over 7,000 support items. The campaign stated activities will resume as soon as the emergency situation allows.

item.title: O motivo que fez Tarcísio de Freitas congelar as agendas de campanha
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas paused his campaign to focus on responding to heavy rains affecting the state. The government sent medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and a mobile Poupatempo unit to assist affected residents. Campaign activities will resume only if the weather stabilizes.

item.title: Dino pede que STF acione Lula e Itamaraty sobre sanções dos EUA
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino suggested that the STF send a statement to President Lula and the Foreign Minister regarding US threats to sanction Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The proposal was made during the Banco Master case trial, as Minister Cármen Lúcia rejected external pressures, defending judicial independence. The case involves investigations into alleged irregularities by Moraes with Daniel Vorcaro and million-dollar contracts with his wife's law firm.

item.title: STF encerra sessão de caso Moraes sem definição; Dino tem 90 dias para ficar com processo
item.description: The STF closed the session on the Moraes case without a ruling, after Justice Flávio Dino requested more time and signaled concern over the 2026 elections. The session was marked by conflicts among justices, failing to resolve even the order-of-business issue raised by Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia se diz “envergonhada” com atual situação do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia expressed embarrassment over the institutional crisis involving the Court and election-related rulings, criticizing external and internal pressures influencing judicial decisions.

item.title: Caso Moraes: 2ª parte da live do STF chega a 179,5 mil aparelhos
item.description: The second part of the live stream covering Alexandre de Moraes' trial at the STF reached 179,500 simultaneous devices, below the 194,500 peak of the morning session. Justices Flávio Dino and Luiz Fux debated the case's rapporteur and investigation procedures, reflecting disagreements over the adopted legal proceedings. The broadcast accumulated 1.2 million views over 7h48min.

item.title: No STF, Dino insinua que Fux recebeu mensagem de Vorcaro; ministro nega
item.description: Justice Flávio Dino suggested that Justice Luiz Fux exchanged messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro, and hinted other justices were also involved. Fux denied having any contact. The clash unfolded during a session analyzing an inquiry into alleged messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Caiado diz que STF "perdeu o rumo" após sessão marcada por bate-bocas
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado harshly criticized the STF after a session marked by heated arguments between justices, stating the institution 'lost its way'. The candidate called the episode a 'degrading spectacle' that embarrasses the country and defended the immediate removal of Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Os próximos passos no STF sobre os pedidos de investigação contra Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: Following a tense session at the Supreme Federal Court, Minister Flávio Dino requested a hold on deciding whether to merge investigations into Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, with a 90-day deadline. The full bench voted 4 to 3 in favor of separating the cases, delaying the merits review. Moraes also released a written defense denying any wrongdoing, and related hearings were suspended.

item.title: ‘Sem presidente, sem comando’, ironiza Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used his free electoral time to mock the STF, claiming 'no president, no command' and blaming the federal government for an alleged imbalance of powers. The criticism came hours after a unprecedented court session. The senator and presidential candidate seized the moment to attack the administration and the Judiciary.

item.title: STF deixa destino de Moraes em suspenso, mas revela cenário favorável à vitória do ministro
item.description: The STF session ended without a concrete decision but signals a favorable scenario for Alexandre de Moraes if investigated, due to a tie among ministers and the rule favoring the defendant. The case involves alleged irregularities in the PF report and a link to Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: “Isso aqui virou um não país”, diz Renan Santos sobre STF
item.description: Missão à Presidência candidate Renan Santos criticized the partial outcome of Tuesday’s session on the Moraes-Vorcaro case, which maintained issues involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He described the 4-3 result as a “terrible mess” and said the country had become “a no-country.” The remark underscores Renan’s criticism of the STF and Moraes.

item.title: Pedido de desculpas de Cármen deveria ser compartilhado pelos colegas
item.description: The column praises Cármen Lúcia's apology to the public but criticizes the unproductive STF session and argues that the other justices should have shared responsibility. It accuses Alexandre de Moraes, Gilmar Mendes and Flávio Dino of disrupting the debate and diverting attention from the possible investigation into contacts with Daniel Vorcaro, while mapping internal court alignments.

item.title: Helder lidera pesquisa para o Senado no PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on September 15, 2026, shows Helder Barbalho (MDB) leading Senate race intentions in Pará with 36%. Delegate Éder Mauro (PL), Chicão (União Brasil), and Zequinha Marinho (Podemos) follow in a technical tie at 16%, 13%, and 13% respectively.

item.title: Renan Santos critica sessão do STF sobre Moraes: "Que pizza horrorosa"
item.description: Renan Santos criticized the STF session on Moraes, calling it a 'horrible pizza'. The session decided to analyze Moraes and Mendonça cases separately, with 4 votes to 3, and was suspended after Flávio Dino requested a vote.

item.title: Para ministros de Lula, Moraes saiu enfraquecido de sessão do STF
item.description: Lula's ministers assess that Alexandre de Moraes left the STF session weakened after failing to get a majority against an investigation request in the Master Case. The partial vote was 4-3 to reject the procedural motion, and Moraes is expected to lack a majority on the merits too. Edson Fachin was praised for steering the session and countering Moraes's maneuvers.

item.title: Janja adesiva carros, canta jingle de Lula e ignora perguntas sobre caso Moraes
item.description: Janja attended a campaign sticker event for Lula's reelection in Brasília and avoided questions about the STF crisis involving Moraes. Lula allies call the investigation request a 'necessary evil,' while Lula only addressed the issue later via TV interview.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia pede desculpas e diz que STF provocou ‘mal-estar cívico’ no País
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia apologized to the country for the civic unrest caused by public frictions among Supreme Court ministers, stating the Court should have acted to prevent the situation. She voted against merging petitions involving Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça in the Banco Master case, alongside Edson Fachin, Mendonça and Fux, and criticized the PGR's authority to request case closures as authoritarian.
